name: lv_image_decoder_get_info

ownership.argument: Source is borrowed for this synchronous call; header_out is caller-owned writable storage of at least 12 bytes.
ownership.return_value: Integer result in r0: 1 on success, 0 on failure; no returned ownership.

provenance.source: Exact .139 AP instruction/call-site inspection and exact-target Unicorn probes; see EVID-RESOURCE-4139-007 byte-window hashes and modeled-leaf boundaries.

notes: Writes a 12-byte image header and returns 1/0. The .139 same-source image setter path reuses this header to update dimensions without source-pointer churn. UI-owner thread only, outside IRQ lock. Static/host evidence is not a physical device probe or general veneer approval.
